payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Still a deliberate parked operator decision (docs/error-tracking.md). Now also holds the source-map and Railway-variables note moved from #YBJVM7, which is unblocked since PR #2871 merged. PRIOR DETAIL: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT are all absent from the production Database service (confirmed 2026-09-16 via Railway list-variables), so next.config.ts skips withSentryConfig entirely and no maps are uploaded. docs/error-tracking.md already records this as a deliberate operator decision, so this is a standing choice rather than a defect. The fragmentation it caused is now fixed independently: the fingerprint normalises build-volatile chunk filenames and mangled identifiers (tests/error-tracking-fingerprint-stability.test.ts). Supplying the three values would still make frames readable, at the cost of build-time provider coupling; the token needs only project release/sourcemap scope. Revisit if a production fault cannot be diagnosed from route, exception type and the stable frame tail alone. PARKED 2026-09-18: docs/error-tracking.md already records leaving the source maps unuploaded as a deliberate operator decision, and supplying the three values is a provider-backed change to production secrets. The fragmentation this caused was fixed independently by the fingerprint normalisation. TO UNBLOCK: only worth revisiting if a production fault cannot be diagnosed from route, exception type and the stable frame tail; then set SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT on the Database service.
